key_findings: Narrative review: cannabis terpenes (BCP, limonene, linalool, humulene, myrcene) show preclinical antinociceptive effects via CB2, TRP channels, NF-κB and COX-2 inhibition.
Clinical translation limited by dose discrepancies, poor pharmacokinetics and lack of RCTs; entourage effect poorly supported.
